You've got a pile of stuff to sell, and zero time to write the listings. What if one photo did it for you?

This is Shelf to Listing. Take a photo of anything you want to sell, upload it, and a vision model looks straight at the item. In a few seconds it hands back a full listing: a title, the category, an honest condition, a description a buyer would actually read, and a fair price with the reasoning behind it. No typing, no guessing what to charge. Try a second item, and it's just as fast, every time structured, ready to post exactly as it is. The model runs through Fireworks, serving open models on AMD Instinct GPUs, so every listing you see here was generated on real AMD hardware.
Shelf to Listing. Snap a photo, get a listing, go sell it. Built for AMD Developer Hackathon Act three, on AMD Instinct GPUs.
